records.process_summary: UT Knoxville publishes a central Financial Aid Appeals hub whose appeal types are Budget Increase, Dependency, HOPE & Institutional Scholarship, SAP, Special Circumstances and Teacher Licensure/Preparatory Course Certification. All documentation must be received at least 14 business days before the last day of classes for the appealed term; appeals not completed within 30 days of a documentation request are canceled.
records.deadline_text: Fall 2026: November 24, 2026; Spring 2027: March 5, 2027; Summer 2027: June 17, 2027.
records.contact_method: Vol Connect case, then MyUTK / CampusLogic forms.
records.notes: Every listed appeal type is a retention, eligibility, dependency, budget or professional-judgment route. None documents reconsideration of an incoming merit award. Not evidence of incoming merit negotiation or competing-offer review; does not qualify the paid add-on.

records.process_summary: The HOPE & Institutional Scholarship Appeals route addresses loss of existing scholarship eligibility due to extenuating circumstances (enrollment drop, withdrawal, non-continuous enrollment, less than full-time, cumulative GPA). No official page reviewed documents a process for reconsidering or increasing an incoming merit award.
records.notes: Do not treat scholarship-retention appeals as proof that UT negotiates initial merit offers. Volunteer/Orange & White tiers accept new official test scores received by May 15 (tests through December); that is an eligibility-data window, not a reconsideration process.

records.process_summary: The official Scholarship FAQ answers "Will UT match scholarship and financial aid offers from other institutions?" with "UT cannot match scholarship or aid offers from other institutions."
records.notes: Upgraded from partially_verified: the 2026-10-02 review found an explicit official negative statement.

records.process_summary: Special Circumstances Appeals for documented financial changes since the FAFSA, such as loss/reduction of employment or income, loss of child support or benefits, divorce/separation, death of a parent or wage earner, unreimbursed medical expenses over 11% of AGI, one-time income events and retirement. One appeal per academic year (August-July); involuntary job-loss appeals wait at least 8 weeks after the event. Listed exclusions include standard living expenses, debts, multiple students in college, and fluctuating commission/self-employment income.
records.required_documents: Tax return transcript and all W-2s/1099s for student and parent (or spouse) plus assigned documentation.
records.contact_method: Vol Connect case, then MyUTK appeal form.
records.notes: Federal professional-judgment route. Not evidence of incoming merit negotiation or competing-offer review; does not qualify the paid add-on.

records.process_summary: HOPE & Institutional Scholarship Appeals: students may appeal loss of HOPE or institutional scholarship eligibility caused by extenuating circumstances (health emergency, death of immediate family member, mental health crisis). Dropping courses to protect GPA does not qualify. HOPE GPA review after a later benchmark and the one-time HOPE grade-replacement option are also handled here. Complete appeals (statement plus documentation) go to the Institutional Review Panel. Chancellor's Scholarship GPA-loss appeals can grant probationary eligibility for one semester.
records.notes: Retention route only. Not evidence of incoming merit negotiation or competing-offer review; does not qualify the paid add-on.

records.process_summary: Budget Increase Appeals for additional education-related expenses (childcare, one-time computer purchase, internship/student teaching, one medical expense per year, extra books/supplies, study abroad). Excludes reimbursed expenses, amounts within the standard allowance, vehicle costs and expenses while not enrolled. Approval does not guarantee additional aid; decisions are final absent new documentation.
records.notes: Not evidence of incoming merit negotiation or competing-offer review; does not qualify the paid add-on.

records.process_summary: Dependency Appeals for a breakdown of the family support unit (e.g., abuse, severe estrangement, abandonment, parental incapacity or incarceration). Self-sufficiency, parental unwillingness to pay and non-claimed tax dependency do not qualify. Reviewed by the Appeal Committee after counselor screening.
records.notes: Not evidence of incoming merit negotiation or competing-offer review; does not qualify the paid add-on.

records.process_summary: Satisfactory Academic Progress appeals to restore federal aid eligibility: personal statement (what happened, what changed, academic plan), third-party documentation and an advisor-signed academic plan; due at least 14 days before the last day of classes for the term.
records.notes: Not evidence of incoming merit negotiation or competing-offer review; does not qualify the paid add-on.

negotiation_addon_gate.reason: No verified incoming merit-reconsideration or competing-offer-review path exists; the official Scholarship FAQ states UT cannot match other institutions' offers. Scholarship-retention, SAP, dependency, budget and special-circumstances appeals do not qualify the product's negotiation add-on.
